channel.title: Nation of Change - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Nation of Change (nationofchange.org)

item.title: Could Trump’s diversion of Venezuelan oil to US save the Iranian regime?
item.description: This substantial gain for the Islamic Republic, however, will only help it weather the current political crisis if it manages to survive until April or May.

item.title: We found more than 40 cases of immigration agents using banned chokeholds and other moves that can cut off breathing
item.description: DHS policy bars using chokeholds and carotid restraints just because someone is resisting arrest. Agents are doing it anyway.

item.title: EPA moves to value human lives at zero in air pollution rules while prioritizing industry costs
item.description: Internal documents show the Trump administration’s EPA is abandoning decades of public health accounting in favor of business compliance costs.

item.title: Noem revives ICE secrecy playbook after Renee Good killing, blocking congressional oversight
item.description: A new DHS order demands seven days’ notice for detention site visits, defying a recent court ruling as Minnesota Democrats are turned away from a Minneapolis facility.
